question: May this dependency refresh merge without successful exact-head previews from both configured Vercel projects?
rationale: The same dependency versions were recently reverted after Vercel deployment failures, while the current preview failures appear to occur before build creation because of external commit-author authorization; code review cannot determine whether local build and browser proof is an acceptable substitute for the repository's hosted gate.

options.title: Require both hosted previews
options.body: Resolve the Vercel author-access configuration and require successful exact-head deployments for both projects before merge.

options.title: Accept equivalent local proof
options.body: Explicitly waive the hosted preview requirement based on the frozen install, audit, repeated builds, and browser validation while owning the remaining deployment uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require both hosted previews
recommendation.body: Resolve the Vercel author-access configuration and require successful exact-head deployments for both projects before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They handled the recent revert specifically for Vercel deployment safety, making them the strongest history-based owner for this release-inclusion choice.
